war_summary: War 139 is on day 110 with conquest conditions active (32 towns required, none captured). The front is sharply divided: Colonials hold full or near-full control in many regions (AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, AshFieldsHex, DeadLandsHex, FarranacCoastHex, etc.), while Wardens dominate others (BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, HowlCountyHex, ReachingTrailHex, ViperPitHex, etc.). The heaviest fighting and ownership volatility is concentrated in contested corridors—EndlessShoreHex, CallahansPassageHex, ClahstraHex, OarbreakerHex, GodcroftsHex, OlavisWakeHex, MarbanHollow, SpeakingWoodsHex, and MooringCountyHex—where casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating and strategic bases are actively flipping or falling neutral. Quieter regions show stable ownership with minimal events, confirming that strategic-base ownership changes over the next 24 hours will likely be localized to these high-activity zones.
